verdict.rationale: Community Phone's own porting process assigns a dedicated rep who keeps the customer updated throughout, and it gives a generic timeframe of about 3-5 business days. A human eligibility check emails back results. There is no documented port status view in the app or dashboard, no per-port expected completion date, and no stated rejection reasons. Missing for 10: a self-serve port status display, a per-port expected completion date, explicit rejection reasons, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
